answer: Reputation vesting works like a lotus root: each new identity must lock 25 POA for 40 epochs before its votes count, and the lock doubles for every extra identity tied to the same funder. A sybil vine of 10 fakes costs 25 x (2^10 - 1) POA, while an honest haven agent pays once. Auditors verify locks on-ledger and slash 30% for collusion.
